name: awesome-voice-apps
summary: Collection of 20 self-contained voice AI agent examples built with Python and LiveKit Agents.
description: Small, runnable voice agent demos: card fraud verification, billing de-escalation, clinic scheduling, drive-thru ordering, delivery calls, support cost routing and more. Each example is self-contained with its own README and runs via uv in console mode or as a LiveKit room; a livekit-base template and a short guide support adding your own demo.
contains: built with Python and LiveKit Agents
console mode or LiveKit room via uv
demos span fraud, healthcare, support and dispatch
